finalText:
Redis died at 02:14:07 and never came back.

When the Redis connection dropped, your cache layer fell back to hitting the store directly. That flooded the store with cache misses, which started timing out at 5 seconds. Requests piled up in the queue (went from 52 to 565+), and the backlog consumed memory faster than it could drain. At 02:31:44—about seventeen minutes in—the Node process ran out of heap space on worker-2. The supervisor tried to restart it, but by then the api was already drowning and unresponsive, so the whole service went down.

The root: **Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 never reconnected.** You made 12 reconnect attempts, all failed with `ECONNREFUSED`. Everything else—the cache miss storm, the queue buildup, the OOM—was the cascade.

Check whether Redis came back online, or if something broke the network to it.
